aboutMe.introduction_one: Hey, I'm Denis. I'm a Fullstack Developer with a passion for building modern, interactive web applications and working with new technologies. I enjoy taking on challenging problems, finding thoughtful solutions, and writing clean, maintainable code. Every project helps me expand my skills and gain hands-on experience. For me, software development is a continuous journey of learning, growth, and turning ideas into meaningful digital experiences.
aboutMe.introduction_two: Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

skills.text: As a Fullstack Developer, I build modern web applications with a strong focus on quality, usability, and clean code. I enjoy learning new technologies, solving complex challenges, and creating thoughtful, maintainable solutions. Continuous learning and professional growth are an essential part of my work and drive me to improve with every project.

projects.introduction: Take a look at the projects I've worked on and the skills I've applied along the way. Each project includes a brief overview, key information, and the opportunity to explore it in more detail.

description.join: Join is a responsive task management app featuring an intuitive Kanban board. Users can create, prioritize and assign tasks, then organize them via drag and drop. Built with Angular, TypeScript and Supabase, the application also provides subtasks, progress tracking, contact management and real-time synchronization.
description.elPolloLoco: A 2D side-scrolling jump-and-run game built with JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas, featuring object-oriented programming, sprite animations, collision detection and an exciting end boss battle.
description.pokemon: An interactive Pokédex application built with JavaScript and the PokéAPI. Browse, search and explore Pokémon with dynamic data fetching and a responsive user interface.
